fullContentHtml:
CCI Various Post Result 2026 – Full Details

Cotton Corporation of India Limited (CCIL) has released the Result for the Junior Commercial Executive, Junior Assistant & Assistant Manager Post. This recruitment was released for 148 posts. Applications for CCI Various Post Recruitment 2026 were accepted from 09 July 2024 to 24 July 2024. The written examination was held on 01 September 2026. Candidates who appeared for this examination can download their CCI Various Post Admit Card 2026 from the link given below.

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 09 July 2026
  • Last Date : 24 July 2026
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 24 July 2026
  • Exam Date : 01 September 2026
  • Exam City Details : 19 August 2026
  • Admit Card : 21 August 2026
  • Answer Key : 03 September 2026
  • Result : 23 October 2026

Application Fee

  • General, EWS, OBC : Rs. 1700/-
  • SC, ST, PH : Rs. 590/-

How to Check Result

  1. Click on the direct official result link provided below.
  2. Enter your Roll Number / Registration Number and Date of Birth.
  3. Submit the form to view your scorecard on screen.
  4. Download and print a copy of the result for future reference.

Important Links

  • Download Result
  • Download Answer Key
  • Download Notification
  • Download Short Notice
  • Official Website

Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

What is CCI Various Post Result 2026?

CCI Various Post Result 2026 is the official result announcement. Candidates can check their scorecard and merit status via the direct link above.

Where can I find the official direct link?

All verified official links are available in the Important Links table above on this page.
